primary_metric: Mean bank absolute log error against the arithmetic mean of 20 A/B outcomes, averaged equally over corpora and primary m<n cells
uncertainty: 5000 crossed bootstrap draws, resampling reference banks and A/B pairs independently while retaining method pairing and nested sizes

decision.target_rule: Common target equals 0.8 times the median 8192-chunk-reference full-source forecast at n=512, saved before A/B scoring
decision.selection: For each reference bank and method, select the smallest grid n whose forecast is at or below the common target. Abstain if no size qualifies.
decision.verification: Compare selected n with mean observed disagreement and a 95% interval across 20 source-separated pairs. Report all selections, target failures and abstentions.
